0022600171.text: The LA Clippers (1-5, 1-1 at home, on a five-game losing streak) sit 13th in the West and 3.5 games back in fourth place in the Pacific, while the Toronto Raptors (3-3, on a two-game losing streak) are 5th in the East and 2.5 games back in third place in the Atlantic. Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Max Strus and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are out for the Clippers, and Derrick Jones Jr. is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle are out for Toronto and Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
